decisions: Use buildSearchForm on both catalog aliases and queries; retain normalizeHead unchanged for lexical identity.
Preserve every colliding family target; query keys never establish or merge identity.
Use the existing v5 persisted alias key (search form with non-alphanumerics removed) only for immutable source-route lookup, explicitly separate from the v6 catalog key.
Language selects accepted family rows and actual source-route member availability, independently; never use one route to suppress another.

Hydrate only current generated accepted memberships. Deduplicate by language and original lemma ID; retain all accepted head/family links and source locators without frequency recomputation or sense apportionment.
Keep raw zero-v5 source measurements addressable both by original ID and an evidence-only normalized word lookup.

Compare raw v5 alias arrays and production candidateEntries separately. Classify exact membership questions against approved additions/corrections and catalog alias-only changes; throw on an unexplained loss of an accepted route.
Do not change catalog, lexical heads, edges, memberships, v5 data, frequencies or historical outputs. Only source-lock and manifest hashes may change during migration replay.
synthetic_tests: Separate in tests/associative-family-v6-shadow.test.mjs; never add synthetic records to corpus registries.
